en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a tall obelisk-like monument topped by a female figure holding three stars. The base of the monument is decorated with large sculptural groups and reliefs. It stands in an open square, with multi‑story historic buildings on either side and a few pedestrians in the foreground. The lower margin of the postcard bears printed text in Latvian.
